_note: Gallery and demo-deck captures (PRD H4, §8): real screenshots of the deployed site, made by scripts/capture_media.py. Five PNG + one GIF, each at most max_bytes (Space Apps project page limit 10 MB).
_viewports_note: Per-shot viewport (CSS px) for full-page shots that also go into the demo deck: close to the deck image slot (544 × 608 px, about 0.9 wide per tall), so the slide shows the whole shot without cropping.

deck_png._note: Demo-deck crops (readable at slide size): each shot = the union of its selectors on the live Compare page, default scenarios. 'open' = a card block opened first. Optional per-shot 'viewport' (CSS px) overrides the deck viewport.
